rows.note: Use this formal noun for the act of putting an error right or for the corrected replacement itself; it is the all-purpose choice here.

example.english: The correction to this document has been issued.
example.traditional: 呢份文件嘅更正已經發出。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 man4 gin6 ge3 gang1 zing3 ji5 ging1 faat3 ceot1

rows.note: Use this for the numerical or physical amount added or subtracted to make an adjustment.

example.english: The correction amount we need to add this time is three kilograms.
example.traditional: 今次要加嘅調整量係三公斤。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 jiu3 gaa1 ge3 tiu4 zing2 loeng6 hai6 saam1 gung1 gan1

rows.note: Use this institutional or legal term for punishment intended to reform or rehabilitate an offender.

example.english: The court ordered two years of correction at an institution.
example.traditional: 法庭判佢入懲教所兩年。
example.jyutping: faat3 ting4 pun3 keoi5 jap6 cing4 gaau3 so2 loeng5 nin4
